subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Nobody fed him when he was starving.

options.text: He had not been fed by anybody when he was starving.
He is not fed by anybody when he is starving.
He were fed by nobody when he was starving.
He was not fed by anybody when he was starving.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'He was not fed by anybody when he was starving.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V₂+ Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Anybody (hidden)'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'him'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'fed' will be changed into 'was fed'. 

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *He was not fed by anybody when he was starving.*
